caveat.text: Co-activity is evidence that accounts act together. It is not evidence that any account is inauthentic, and it does not show what any account intends. Every link shows the evidence behind it. See the methodology.

edge_phrases.hashtag_sequence: used the same hashtag sequence as

methodology_negative_results.language_rule: This site does not call any account coordinated, a bot, a troll or inauthentic. The detector surfaces accounts that are co-active under stated parameters, and nothing more.
